intro: Add the pets you want to level. For each pet, pick the level it is at now and the level you want. A pet advances at every level that is a multiple of 10 and needs the advancement to go past that level.

picker.allAdded: Every pet is in the list.
picker.advanceAtMax: Also advance at the max level

row.keepsAdvancement: The pet keeps its advancement at this level.

empty: No pet added yet. Add a pet above to see the pet food, the advancement items and the gains.

results.title: Results
results.unknownPowerNote: The game data has no advanced power for some advancement levels, so the power gain of these pets is Unknown.

resources.title: Resources
resources.empty: Choose a goal above the current level to see the resources.

events.title: Event points from the advancement score
events.note: Event points are the advancement score times the points of the "Pet advancement score increases by 1" row of each event. {hallOfChief} has no pet row.

byPet.title: By pet
byPet.empty: No pet gains a level or an advancement yet.
